'''Car'ulorn's Kavsrach''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] restaurant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that opened in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. It specialized in [[Gornt/Legends|Gornt]] and [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] dishes such as [[Mynock Coronet City/Legends|Mynock Coronet City]].<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
